text: 72-year-old male. The patient has experienced gradual yellow discoloration of the skin and generalized pruritus over the past 2 weeks. The patient has abstained from alcohol for these three years, after having consumed 1–2 beers daily for 40 year...

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Cholangiocarcinoma. The combination of progressive jaundice, significant weight loss, pale stools, dark urine, and a history of biliary pain (suggesting a prior stone or stricture) in a 72-year-old male is highly indicative of a malignant obstruction of the common bile duct.

REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Tests, CA 19-9, Abdominal CT with contrast.
